$comment: Machine-readable mirror of @nx/enforce-module-boundaries in eslint.config.mjs. Source of truth for what each layer AND each vertical may import. Keep in sync with eslint.config.mjs; the lint rule is authoritative.

shared.responsibility: Result/Either, branded types, clock & logger contracts.

domain.responsibility: Entities, value objects, business rules, domain events. Pure.

application.responsibility: Use cases, port TYPES, DTOs, and flows (headless controllers + ViewModel/registry). Orchestration only — framework-free.

infrastructure.responsibility: Adapters: Dexie, REST, JWT auth, sync engine.

ui.responsibility: Design system + feature screens + stores. Components read ViewModels via stores and dispatch actions; orchestration lives in application flows.

app.responsibility: Composition roots. The only place concrete adapters are wired.

verticals.$comment: Second, orthogonal axis (ADR-0019): every project carries one layer:* tag AND one vertical:* tag. Nx requires a dependency to satisfy every matching constraint, so the axes compose. Adding a vertical = one entry here + one depConstraint in eslint.config.mjs.

core.responsibility: Vertical-agnostic engines: access, billing, the design system, the DI seam factory, shared identity chrome.
core.note: Shared code may depend only on shared code. Known exception: the Item example still lives in libs/{domain,application,infrastructure}/src/example because the ADR-0007 sync engine is written against it — see ADR-0019.

bison.responsibility: The Bison vertical (the shipping product): its screens, DI bundle and apps.

lab.responsibility: The reference implementation of a vertical — the canonical Item slice and the template apps. Never deployed; it is also the canary that keeps core generic.
